count_unit: unique original training target/parent; no augmentation or duplicate inflation

cohort_policy.selection: fixed hash within paper/author strata before model outputs
cohort_policy.insufficient_stratum: pause; do not relax quality or change composition silently
cohort_policy.frozen_prefix: Retain earlier stage rows/versions exactly as new data arrive; append eligible targets rather than reranking the old cohort.

method: direct SFT first; one epoch, fixed fresh base snapshot, QLoRA settings, prompt and decoding; practical data-plus-compute curve
compute_interpretation: fixed epochs imply increasing optimizer updates and tokens; practical data-plus-compute curve, not a pure data-only causal effect

evaluation.detector_scores: native label and scale, provider/date/version; not calibrated probabilities of authorship
evaluation.floor_rule: report uninformative endpoint if baseline/controls leave no useful dynamic range; do not select detector-positive examples after outcomes

promotion_gate.meaning: no material drift allowed per eligible output; report minor and unresolved separately
promotion_gate.detector: improvement versus fixed base and preceding stage only interpreted if endpoint informative; retain all outcomes
promotion_gate.failure: pause and diagnose; no automatic next GPU stage

detector_budget: sparse user-supplied PDFs under ordinary account quota; no account multiplication or paid access assumed
